description: ᴊᴀᴠᴀsᴄʀɪᴘᴛ ᴡʜᴀᴛsᴀᴘᴘ ʙᴏᴛ ᴄʀᴇᴀᴛᴇᴅ ʙʏ Kɢ ᴛᴇᴄʜ

ALIVE_IMG.description: paste your image url if you don't have you can use this public url.

PREFIX.description: paste your bot prefix note! Don't apply null please prefix.

MODE.description: select your bot work type public-private-inbox-group.

AUTO_VOICE.description: Make it true if you want bot auto voice.

AUTO_REPLY.description: Make it true if you want bot auto reply.

AUTO_STICKER.description: Make it true if you want bot auto sticker.

AUTO_READ_STATUS.description: Make it true if you want bot auto auto_read_status.

ANTI_LINK.description: Make it true if you want bot auto remove group link.

ANTI_BAD.description: Make it true if you want bot auto delete bad words from group example xxx porn etc.

FAKE_RECORDING.description: Make it true if you want bot fake record.

AUTO_REACT.description: Make it true if you want bot AutoReact.

OWNER_REACT.description: Make it true if you want bot OwnerReact.

HEART_REACT.description: Make it true if you want bot only heart ♥️ emjois reaction .

STATUS_REACT.description: Make it true if you want the bot to auto react to contacts' statuses.

AUTO_REPLY_STATUS.description: Make it true if you want the bot to auto reply to contacts' statuses.

STATUS_REPLY.description: The text message the bot will send when auto replying to statuses.

READ_MESSAGE.description: Make it true if you want the bot to auto mark every incoming message as read.

READ_CMD.description: Make it true if you want the bot to auto mark command messages as read.

ANTI_DEL_PATH.description: Set to "log" to send deleted messages to the bot owner's DM, or anything else to resend them in the original chat.

ANTI_CALL.description: Make it true if you want the bot to automatically reject incoming calls.

ANTI_SPAM.description: Make it true if you want the bot to auto detect and ignore spamming users.

AUTO_DOWNLOAD.description: Make it true if you want the bot to auto download YouTube/Facebook/TikTok links sent in chat.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Extra owner numbers, comma-separated, without + or spaces (example: 237600000000,237611111111).
